sentences.en: The teacher is likely to get angry with the students.
sentences.zh: 老师可能会生学生的气。

sentences.en: Teachers should occasionally let their students blow off some steam.
sentences.zh: 老师们偶尔也应该让学生放松一下。

sentences.en: Some college teachers come to class late and leave early.
sentences.zh: 有些大学老师上课迟到早退。

senses.zh: 教师，教员，老师，先生,航教练机
